Name: Less Ugly Hospital and or Clinic
Author: 0Renciel
Description:
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=5][u][b][color=#f4f4f4][i]Less Ugly Hospital/Clinic[/i][/color][/b]

[/u][/size][size=3]A very simple mod with an unusually long description.[/size]

[size=3]So, you passed out in the middle of town and get brought back by Harvey to get medical treatment.  He scams you out of 5k gold and you think to yourself, where does all your hard working money go?[/size]
[size=3]Looking around his Clinic, you definitely know it doesn't go there. Does he spend it on moustache preservation treatments? Is he buying more DIY surgery books? Maybe he's trying to buy a plane he's never gonna be able to pilot.[/size]

[size=3]In any case, we all know It's pretty plain and boring. The blue floors with the Green walls just burns my eyes even with recolors, so I then decided to continue on my "Less Ugly" series.[/size]

[s]I plan to eventually make a whole town interior and exterior change perhaps bundled all together or separated for those who only wants specific areas in the future, but in the mean time I'll continue posting individual map edits whilst I gather enough motivation lol.[/s][size=3] [/size]
[size=4][b][i]Say no more, full version is available [/i][/b][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12442][size=4][b][i]HERE![/i][/b][/size][/url]

[color=#ea9999][size=5][b][i][u]NEW!! 1.0.4
[/u][/i][/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Changed the floors completely[/size][/font]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Added [color=#a4c2f4][b][u]Compatibility[/u][/b][/color] version - This is good for those who has many custom npcs/other mods that touches the clinic. Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM![/url][/size][/font]﻿
[/list][color=#ea9999][size=3][u][b]
No, it still won't work with SVE.[/b][/u][/size][/color]

[size=3]This has the most simplest coding that is known to man, so though I dread it I know there will be bugs and whatnot that I have overlooked. If you've spotted one, feel free to send a bug report [/size][u][b]AFTER[/b][/u][size=3] reading below. Bug reports from those who has clearly not read the mod description will be ignored and/or deleted![/size]

[size=4][i]Enjoy![/i][/size]


[size=5][u][b][i][color=#ff0000]Very Important, Read me![/color][/i][/b]

[/u]What this mod [u][i][b][color=#ff0000]DOESN'T[/color][/b][/i][/u] do:[/size]

[size=4][b][s]1. Add a night time version..NOT[/s][/b][/size][size=3]
[/size] 
[size=3][s][b]SIKE![/b] I didn't edit any of the windows, so the night should come to those (Haven't tested it out though, but what are you even doing in the Clinic/Hospital past 4?). But what [i][b]does[/b] [/i]shine eternally is the lamps and lights. Oh Harvey, not very eco friendly are ya?

[/s]Knocked some sense into Harvey :)[/size]

[size=4][b]2. Edits the Heart events[/b]
[/size][size=3]
I made this mod with the VANILLA heart events in mind. So in theory, it should work fine [u]without[/u] any mods that expands on the Hospital/Clinic, changes it's interiors, or adds any cutscenes inside the Hopsital/Clinic.

[u][b]Now, in relation to that I am not sure how well this mod works with a big expansion.[/b][/u]

[/size][size=4][b]3. Gives the farmer a discount[/b][/size]

[size=3]I know right? So ridiculous! I fix up his ugly Clinic free of charge and he [i]still [/i]has the audacity to charge me 5k just for sleeping on my [b]OWN DOORSTEP. [/b]A scammer I tell you.


[/size][color=#f4f4f4][size=5][u][b][i]Compatibilities[/i][/b][/u][/size][/color]


[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]East Scarp[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], It's fine.[/size]
[u][color=#00ff00][size=4][b]RidgeSide Village[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4],[/size][size=4] It is also fine.[/size]
[u][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Stardew Valley Expanded[/b][/size][/color][/u][size=4], [/size][size=4]I don't know chief, but I'm gonna say [b]no.
[/b][color=#00ff00][b]Jasper[/b] [/color](Or any mod that touches the Clinic), use the [u][color=#c9daf8][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/u] version.
[/size]
[size=4][u][b]Don't worry,[/b][/u][/size][size=4] [/size][size=3]about mods that adds any heart events in the Clinic. Just use the [u][color=#c9daf8][b]Compatibility[/b][/color][/u] version![/size]
[b][u][size=4]Regarding SVE[/size][/u][/b][size=3], I'm pretty certain that SVE changes the Hospitals/Clinics interior, which would cause problems if you use this alongside that. [/size][size=3]What problems you ask? Well I also don't know, hey if it does work then c'est la vie.[/size]
